content.short: ChangeHero is an instant non-custodial exchange service supporting 300+ digital assets.
content.description: ChangeHero performs instant swaps between several hundred assets without requiring an account, sourcing rates from liquidity partners and settling directly to a user's wallet. Monad's documentation lists it under cross-chain tooling. Services of this shape occupy the gap between a full exchange, which requires onboarding, and a DEX, which requires the user already hold the right gas token.
